blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Discusses the Type of Insurance a Small Business Needs

Among the most baffling challenges confronting small business owners is determining exactly what types of insurance to carry. Make no mistake, though, an improperly insured business is vulnerable to all sorts of loss – including embezzlement, lawsuits, a natural disaster and more. How is a business owner to know what kinds of policies to purchase?

A [CPA in Tampa](http://www.reliancecpa.com//index.html) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help with all of your small business accountancy needs, including determining your insurance requirements. Since opening our doors in 1984, Reliance has helped hundreds of businesses in the Tampa Bay area reach their maximum potential. While business owners concern themselves with perfecting their ability to deliver goods and services to their clients, a small business consultant from Reliance handles the payroll services, cash flow management, tax preparation and other financial minutia.
